entrar.texto: You will see {{empresa}} as its Administrator sees it, for 1 hour. Read-only unless you ask for write access.
entrar.motivo_dica: E.g. the Administrator asked for help closing the till.
entrar.motivo_visivel: Required. The company sees the reason in its list of support sessions.
entrar.aviso_escrita: Whatever you change is done as the company’s Administrator, with your name in the audit log. The company sees that this session could write.

sessoes.subtitulo: When someone from the platform entered your company to help: who, why and whether they could change data.
sessoes.vazio: The platform has not entered your company yet.
